body: Closes S170-101, logged earlier tonight and left unstarted pending a check for which existing 'compression' thread it continued. Checked all 77 live posts before writing -- found the real thread: 'Vibe Coding Is a Skill Issue' parts 1-3 use compression as a genuine philosophical throughline, never literally about an algorithm. Part 4 cashes that in for a real, technically accurate LZ4 deep-dive (4-byte minimum match, hash-chain match finder, token format, why the format's simplicity buys multi-GB/s decode speed vs zstd/gzip's better ratio) that closes the loop back to the series' actual argument. Live at https://okemily.com/blog/vibe-coding-is-a-skill-issue-part-4/. OKEMILY ee4cafe.
title: Blog: 'Vibe Coding Is a Skill Issue, Part 4' (LZ4 deep-dive) -- closes S170-101
